notes.title: Catch Mafia Pigs at Steam Stealth Fest
notes.notes:
Get ready for another chance to try out the quirky sneak-fest that is Mafia Pigs. Try single-player campaign levels to hone your skills, and then gather some friends for the Stealth Royale multiplayer competitive mode. Get to the Golden Acorn and escape without triggering the guards or getting relieved of your prize!

The game is still free and fits right into stealth fest. Looking forward to seeing you creeping around the halls of the Mafia Pigs mansion!

notes.title: Update including a new heist Royale Multiplayer Map
notes.notes:
Mafia Pigs has been live for over a week now, and we already have thousands of activations. Lots of fun from players too. Thank you for playing the game, those that already did! 

We’ve just updated the game on Steam to add a few additional features and bug fixes in. So if you haven’t tried it yet, there’s never been a better time! New in this version:

Controller fixes so gamepad controllers now work fully. 

An all-new mission map for multiplayer, so you can now choose between two.

Guard AI fixes to make your lives just that little bit easier in a few places!

We highly recommend the multiplayer version of the game. It’s easy to get into and a lot of fun. So grab a couple of friends and compete to see who can pull off the biggest Heist!

notes.title: Mafia Pigs is Live!
notes.notes:
The Mafia Pigs are in flight! Welcome to the new free Mafia Pigs game - sneak your devious mafia character around the exciting levels to steal the city’s brightest treasures!

Play in multiplayer mode against your friends or in public games of up to 6 players. Try out the single-player levels to learn the ropes and get ready for the competitive Heists!

Thank you for all the support during development. We hope the game brings you a ton of fun!

notes.title: Mafia Pigs :: Launch Event!
notes.notes: Mafia Pigs goes free today! Join us for the announcements, play-throughs, and discussions amongst the Dev team. Get some insights on how to play as well as the skinny behind the decisions that went into making the game!

notes.title: Mafia Pigs Development continues on the Alpha Test Branch!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all those that played out demo during Steam NextFest! It was amazing to see so many players and so much feedback! 

The demo branch has now been removed from the Steam page. Even though you'll still be able to play it a while longer, it won't be updated with the latest changes. To get those, please join our Alpha playtest program. This is where all the action will be!

If you previously had an Alpha key, this will still work. If not, you can get one either by joining the mailing list at [url=http://mafiapigs.com]http://mafiapigs.com[/url] or the Discord at [url=http://timewarp.com/discord]http://timewarp.com/discord[/url].

More news about upcoming roadmaps and releases soon!

notes.title: The Mafia Pigs #SteamNextFest Demo is here!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to be sharing the new demo of Mafia Pigs with you all. The demo has two single-player missions and a randomized competitive multiplayer mode that you can play many times. Play either with friends (private games) or public games (online matchmaking). 

We’re also organizing an online live play tournament this week to coincide with prizes and glory at stake. Check out tournament information [url=https://timewarp.com/nftournament]here[/url]. Join the [url=https://timewarp.com/discord]game discord[/url] for feedback and tournament information. 

In the game, show your skills by pulling off the heist before anybody else and using the environment to give them the run-around in the process. Hitman meets AmongUs and Hunt Showdown wrapped in a funky cartoon wrapper? Something like that :-). Enjoy!
